Copas 1.0.9

A productivity and window management release introducing Pin-to-Screen scratchpad mode for sequential multi-pasting, full board movability and dragging, direct action buttons in preview, and bounded clean image rendering.

  • Pin-to-Screen (Scratchpad Mode): Press ⌘⇧P or click the pin icon in the search bar to lock Copas on screen. The board remains open as a persistent floating palette while pasting multiple clips or switching between apps, complete with an accent badge in the status bar.
  • Effortless Sequential Multi-Pasting: Easily paste multiple items into Google Docs, Word, Notes, or Slack without repeatedly reopening the board. New dedicated [Paste] (↩) and [Copy] (⌘↩) buttons in the preview header allow instant one-click pasting.
  • Draggable Board Window: The clipboard manager panel can now be freely dragged and positioned anywhere across displays using the top capsule handle, search bar margins, or bottom status bar.
  • Bounded & Clean Image Display: Image clips now render with responsive bounded dimensions, eliminating oversized overflow and chess/checkerboard background patterns while preserving crisp 1:1 pixel fidelity.
  • Swift 6 Concurrency Updates: Refined actor isolation and concurrency conformance in settings and updater coordinators.

Your existing clips, settings, and database are preserved seamlessly.

Copas 1.0.8

A major capability release adding robust image capture, system-wide drag and drop, and Apple Intelligence Writing Tools integration with live clip editing.

  • Image Capture from Web & Apps: Copying images from web browsers (Safari, Chrome, Firefox) and image tools now reliably stores the picture as an image clip rather than an image URL. Supports PNG, TIFF, JPEG, and HEIC, automatically normalized to canonical PNG.
  • Drag & Drop to Any App: Drag images directly from the clipboard list or the preview panel straight into Finder, Desktop, Mail, Messages, Slack, Discord, Safari, Figma, or any file drop target. Text clips can also be dragged directly into editors.
  • Apple Intelligence Writing Tools: On macOS 15+ (Sequoia), utilize Apple Intelligence Writing Tools to proofread, rewrite in different tones (Friendly, Professional, Concise), summarize, or extract key points and tables directly inside Copas.
  • Editable Clips & Immediate Sync: Text clips can now be edited directly within the board. Press ⌘S or click Save to update the clip in the database, refresh full-text search, and synchronize the updated content directly to your active system clipboard.

Your existing clips, settings and shortcuts are preserved seamlessly.

Copas 1.0.7

A stability and performance update resolving a UI freeze and refining color filters.

  • Asynchronous App Icon Resolution: App icon lookups for clips now resolve in the background off the main thread. Even if macOS LaunchServices takes time to query custom or cloned application bundles, the Copas board remains completely fluid and responsive with zero UI stalling.
  • Refined Colors Filter: The Colors smart filter now strictly targets actual color values (hex codes like #FF5733, #fff, and CSS functions like rgb(), hsl()), preventing Markdown notes and headings starting with # from being mistakenly categorised as colors.
  • Filter Empty State: When a filter has no matching clips, the board now shows a helpful "No clips match" search empty state rather than "Nothing copied yet".

Your clips, settings and shortcuts are untouched by this update.
